quarterly_data.quarter: SemiFive press release: SEMIFIVE Accelerates Growth with 97% YoY Revenue Surge in (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 bookings of KRW 118.9 billion (71% of full-year 2025 bookings of KRW 168.4 billion). Mass production bookings reached KRW 42.3 billion in H1, nearly twice the KRW 21.2 billion for full-year 2025; quarterly mass production bookings rose approximately 71% from KRW 15.6 billion in Q1 to KRW 26.7 billion in Q2, with overseas customers approximately 45% (KRW 12.1 billion) of Q2 bookings. IP business (subsidiary Analog Bits) bookings KRW 32.1 billion, 77.3% of full-year 2025 bookings (KRW 41.5 billion); advanced-node 2 nm and 3 nm IP revenue continued to grow.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 bookings KRW 118.9 billion; mass production bookings KRW 42.3 billion (Q1 KRW 15.6 billion, Q2 KRW 26.7 billion, overseas ~45% of Q2); IP bookings KRW 32.1 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: SemiFive press release: SEMIFIVE Accelerates Growth with 97% YoY Revenue Surge in (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 gross margin rose 18.7 percentage points year over year from 11.9% to 30.6%, and operating margin improved 47.0 percentage points to -11.5%. The mass production business is entering a full-scale ramp-up phase on continued follow-on POs for vision AI, on-device AI and data center AI chips, with rapidly growing demand from North American, European and Asian customers for 3D-IC-based high-performance AI semiconductor projects. CEO Brandon Cho: with backlog and production volumes progressively translating into revenue and an expanding pipeline of new ASIC development opportunities, "we expect our growth momentum to strengthen further in the second half of the year."
